headline: Peruvian Central Bank Rate Hikes Drive Up Housing Mortgage Costs
summary: Interest rate adjustments by Peru's Central Reserve Bank (BCRP) have increased mortgage financing rates across commercial banks, raising costs for prospective home buyers.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions directly influence commercial lending rates, consumer mortgage affordability, and private real estate sector activity.

impacts.name: Peru Real Estate Sector
impacts.why: Higher central bank policy rates led directly to elevated mortgage borrowing costs for home buyers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Monetary tightening by the BCRP raised mortgage borrowing rates across Peruvian commercial banks.
